wholePhysicalScope: Native cadastral outline and USDA 30 cm orthophoto set dimensions and roof footprint. The photographed corner chamfer is restored to the simplified mapped outline.
lodDetails: Four runtime levels retain the surveyed central enclosure, main plinth and southern approach.
limitations: Roof and rear service volumes match the cleared aerial and contemporary footprint. Small plaster ornament is represented as shaped relief and fine interior detail is out of scope.
Colors use neutral light masonry, pale decorative trim and desaturated roofing. Exact paint and individual carved reliefs are approximate.
